name: Chia Seeds
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as they're FODMAP-free, but high fiber content may cause digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Soak in liquid for 10-15 minutes to create a gel-like consistency that's easier to digest
Start with smaller amounts (1 tsp) and gradually increase to assess tolerance
Grind seeds for better nutrient absorption and easier digestion
Always consume with adequate liquid to prevent digestive blockage
pairsWellWith: Low-FODMAP fruits like strawberries or kiwi
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids (ALA)
Rich in protein with all essential amino acids
Good source of calcium, phosphorus, and magnesium
